capabilities: Store password entries in an AES-256-GCM encrypted vault protected by a master password
Organize entries with groups, favorites, and search by name, login, URL, and notes
Generate passwords with configurable length and character set
Import and export CSV from browsers and other password managers
Merge per-entry changes when the vault is synced across devices
extras: Readme is bilingual (Russian and English). Notes that a forgotten master password cannot be recovered, that CSV export produces plaintext passwords, and that the plugin makes no network requests. Installable via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to store passwords and other credentials securely within a vault.
summary: Encrypted password vault inside the vault with groups, search, a password generator, CSV import/export, and per-entry merge across synced devices.
